independence: Learner author and source editor; did not author or typeset the separate key. Reviewed the accepted key pages without modifying either master, TeX or shared files.
method: All 24 v1 pages were directly inspected through view_image. All 14 changed v2 pages (5–18) were reopened at original resolution and inspected in full. The remaining 10 final images were independently compared by SHA-256 and exact bytes with their directly inspected v1 predecessors. The current final PDF and all 24 final image identities were verified; hash checks did not substitute for inspection of changed content.
